corrections.text: The article's "What We Don't Know" section states the $800 million annualized revenue figure "was attributed by both outlets to a person familiar with the matter speaking to Bloomberg." Only SiliconANGLE's report uses that sourcing language ("a person familiar with the matter told Bloomberg"); TechCrunch attributes the figure more generally to "Bloomberg's report" without specifying that sourcing. Both outlets agree the figure did not come from a company disclosure.
